content.value: Write down the minimum requirements and skills that a clinical engineering technolojist (I 0) should have. A hospital has 200 machines and the CE supervises the BMETs who repair malfunctioning machines. The maintenance policy is to repair the broken down machine and bring them back in service within 2 hours (on average). If the average breakdown rate is 3.5 machines/hour and each BMET can repair 0.25 machine/hour (on average), how many BMETs are required?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
